chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Ziyad narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Sabah ibn al-Dhahak narrated to me, saying: Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Hadrami narrated to us, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad narrated to us, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him), saying:

As-Sufyani is red, blond, and blue-eyed. He has never worshipped Allah at all, and he has not seen Mecca nor Medina at all. He says: 'O my Lord, my revenge [even] with the Fire, O my Lord, my revenge [even] with the Fire.'

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: As-Sufyani, a specific messianic figure in Shia eschatology
key_terms.الْمَدِينَةَ: Medina, the second holy city in Arabia
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Mecca, the holy city in Arabia

ai.seo_question: What are the physical and spiritual characteristics of As-Sufyani according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Baqir (AS) provides the definitive physical and spiritual profile of As-Sufyani, emphasizing his lack of piety through his failure to perform Hajj or worship God, which contrasts with his intense, albeit misguided, zeal for vengeance. His repeated cry, 'O Lord, my revenge and the Fire,' highlights the eschatological theme of a tyrant who embraces Hellfire for the sake of political retribution, a key motif in Shia ghayba literature regarding the Mahdi's rise.
